n-f-1.reason: pro uĩcia = prouincia, the tilde marking the omitted n (l. Qui in provincia); uicia without the tilde is no word.

n-h-0.reason: l. ij. C. soluto matrimonio is the number Coras gives the same law at Annotation XI (l. ij. C. ſol. marr., annot-011 note f); nothing supports iij.; Same line as p134-m2l0-1, so the same choice; ſol. and ſol are the same abbreviation of soluto with or without the point.

n-h-1.reason: Accurſe is Coras's usual spelling of Accursius throughout the margins; Accurſè with a grave is a stray accent.

n-l-3.reason: annot-095 note l: the same line abbreviates *qui* with the ꝗ sign (*ꝗ no bis*), so *ꝗ fil. ſint leg.* is the consistent reading; the title is *qui filii sint legitimi* (cf. note b *qui fil ſint legi.*).

n-q-1.reason: bona. = the Authentica Bona damnatorum in C. de bonis proscriptorum; bova is no word.
